name: Dili International Marathon 2026
short_description: Dili International Marathon 2026 is a verified Full/Half/10K/5K event in Dili, Timor-Leste, confirmed for 8 August 2026.
ai_summary: Dili International Marathon 2026, themed "Love Our Forests and Wildlife," is organized by the Federacao de Timor-Leste de Atletismo and confirmed for 8 August 2026 in Dili. The event offers a Full Marathon, Half Marathon, Para 10K, and 5K Fun Run. Pricing is differentiated: international entrants pay $45 (Half) or $90 (Full) in USD, while Timorese nationals run free.

core_facts.price_range: USD 45 (Half, international) / USD 90 (Full, international) / free for Timorese nationals

pros: Out-and-back waterfront course to Cristo Rei, which the organiser describes as flat and certified
Small fields with a US$77,400 prize fund: a 3:35 marathon won US$2,000 in 2026
Seven paired water and medical points, passed on the way out and back
Free entry for Timorese runners and a free 5 km with no registration
cons: Only 50 marathon finishers in 2026, so much of the second lap is run alone
No cut-off or detailed entry rules were published
Very few women in the field: 16 of 50 marathon finishers
research_highlights: Established in 2010 as part of the 'Dili City of Peace' campaign, making it one of Timor-Leste's longest-running international sporting events, per official presidential press releases.
The 2026 edition (the 10th) is fixed for 8 August 2026 and includes a Full Marathon (42.195km), Half Marathon (21.1km), 10km Para-Athletics race, and 5km Fun Run.
All races start and finish at the Nicolau Lobato Presidential Palace on Dili's waterfront, per TATOLI coverage of the 2025 edition.
Organisers have moved to a fixed annual date (second week of August) starting in 2026, aiming to end previous scheduling uncertainty, according to a presidential press release.
The event has historically drawn thousands of runners and community participants, with the 2012 edition reporting almost 8,000 people across the marathon, half marathon, and 'Run for Peace' events.
research_watchouts: An independent report on the inaugural 2010 race documented significant litter problems: plastic water bottles, cans, and Styrofoam packaging were left behind with no recycling bins available, and a nearby boat captain described waking up to bottles floating in the harbor the next day.
The same report noted Timor-Leste had no waste treatment plant or recycling facilities at the time, a broader infrastructure gap flagged as a concern for large events like the marathon.

Recent editions are largely covered through official government/presidential press releases and sponsor announcements rather than independent participant race reports, so first-hand accounts of course conditions, aid stations, or heat management for the 2024-2026 editions are scarce in public sources.

faqs.question: When is the Dili International Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Dili International Marathon 2026 is confirmed for 8 August 2026 in Dili, Timor-Leste. It is organized by the Federacao de Timor-Leste de Atletismo, and the date is stated on the official race website.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to enter the Dili International Marathon?
faqs.answer: International runners pay USD 45 for the Half Marathon or USD 90 for the Full Marathon. Timorese nationals can enter either distance for free.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Dili International Marathon?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distances: a Full Marathon (42.195km), a Half Marathon (21.1km), a Para 10K category, and a 5K Fun Run. This range makes the event accessible to competitive marathoners, first-time half-marathon runners, para-athletes, and casual participants at the same race weekend.
